verdict.rationale: The Editor API is explicitly billed for scripting custom tools and integrating external systems (playcanvas-docs-9), and the community references playcanvas-sync for mapping project assets to a local filesystem (playcanvas-comm-10) and the MCP server for programmatic project data changes (playcanvas-docs-6), all of which imply some automation capability. However, there is no documented import-hook system, asset presets, or a dedicated pipeline-scripting API specifically for processing incoming assets automatically. Missing for 10: explicit asset import hooks, configurable import presets, documented pipeline scripts triggered on asset ingestion, and independent confirmation these tools eliminate manual per-asset clicking.
